Susanna Haswell Rowson, Charlotte Temple.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/susanna-haswell-rowson/charlotte-temple

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Susanna Haswell Rowson, the author, died 1824.
- Francis Whiting Halsey, the annotator, died 1919.

First publication of the text used: 1791 (SE colophon: 'Charlotte Temple was published in 1791 by Susanna Haswell Rowson.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the rights statement quoted below places the text in the United States public domain. The text was first published in 1791, before 1931.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
